name: Columbia (STS-75)
about: Columbia (STS-75) (1996-012A), a crewed vehicle (OV-102), launched 1996 Feb 22. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1996 Feb 29), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KSC RW33); its coordinates are written from memory
